name: photobook-layouts
title_zh: 给相册排版器补格子的布局生成器
tagline_zh: 客户在 Design Tool 里翻来翻去只有那几种摆法，一页放几张、横竖怎么搭全靠手摆。
tagline_en: When the Design Tool's layout picker feels thin, this generates whole sets of photo-frame arrangements for a.
desc_en: Use when adding, designing or generating layouts for a Pixfizz design theme - the photo frame arrangements a customer picks from in the Design Tool. Triggers on "add new layouts", "create photo book layouts", "we need more layout options", "fill the blank layouts", "generate a layout set", "more one-photo and two-photo layouts", "the layout picker is too thin", "design some collage arrangements",
why_zh: 它认的是主题里已有的相框规格和槽位约束，所以生成的布局能直接进选择器。
why_en: It reads the theme's existing frame specs and slot constraints, so generated layouts drop into the picker directly instead of.
limit_zh: 只服务 Pixfizz 设计主题的相框体系，脱离这套规格就无从下手；产出到布局定义为止，不碰照片裁切、配色和印刷出血。
limit_en: Only works inside Pixfizz theme frame systems; output stops at layout definitions — no cropping, color, or bleed; it halts and asks if frame specs.
title_en: Layout generator that fills gaps in a photobook picker
